_doc.mode: cascade = cheapest sufficient tier by evidence; cloud = LLM drafts every placement; local = local model every placement; deterministic = no model, suggestion straight to a person
_doc.allow_cloud: cascade only: may escalate to the cloud model (a privacy/cost opt-in). Ignored when mode is an explicit tier.
_doc.local_available: whether a local model is wired; when false, cascade falls back to cloud (if allowed) or review
_doc.dominance: cascade tuning: top-1 must lead top-2 by this fraction of top-1 to be 'one clear domain' (regex tier)
_doc.min_signal: cascade tuning: overlap below this is treated as no real signal (novel → cloud/review)
_doc.note: This example lives with the skill (code side). The REAL file is user data — keep it in the Knowledge workspace, not in the engine repo.
